Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

Active
[Active - Hold] Predation: On use, creates a black mist (breath) up to a 10 block (shifting and using the ability will change the block consumption between only blocks, liquids or both, slideable range with scroll mouse. Max 15 with mastery) radius in front of the player If it comes into contact with a mob, deals 50 damage, applies Corrosion for 5 seconds, and drains 1000 MP, with a 30% chance to gain 1-3 random Intrinsic, Common, Extra, or Resists skill/s from the target. If an enemy is killed by Predation, gains all of their Intrinsic, Common, Extra and Resists skills. With Mastery, if a Magic projectile is eaten, then the player gains that magic. For the first time killing a type of mob, targets killed have 50% (Configurable) of their ep added to the players max instead of the usual 3%. This can be toggled to consume blocks using shift + ability key while on the predation mode, which will automatically be added to Stomach.
Active: [Active - Press] Stomach: When activated, grants access to a spatial storage with the size of a chest with 9 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 666 instead of 64.
Active: [Active - Hold] Corrosion: Costs 200 MP and deals 10 Corrosion damage every 10 ticks to all enemies in a 10x10 radius. Enemies killed by this have their Resists, Intrinsic, Common, and Extra Skills taken by the player.
Active: [Active - Press] Receive: Intrinsic, Common, and Extra skills owned by the player's subordinates are given to the player.
Active: [Active - Press] Isolation: Consumes held item and restores mp similar to Absorb and Dissolve, but with twice the restored mp. If nothing is held and the player is looking at a target, remove all negative status effects from that target. If used while empty handed and not looking at a mob, removes all negative status effects from the player [Costs 100 MP each effect level removed].

Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Absolute Guard: Blocks all attacks with a formula of C = A * 25. C = Cost, A = Attack Damage. Attacks from an opponent with 75% or higher the user's EP can bypass it.
Active
[Active - Press] - Imprison: At the cost of 50,000MP + 50% of the Targets EP, imprisons the mob/player the player is looking at. Seals all movement, skill usage and healing. Drains MP from the trapped target at a rate of 500 per 10 ticks. Lasts for 300 seconds. Increases to 600 seconds with mastery - 20s cooldown - Goes on CD if you Miss (10s with Mastery).
50,000 MP + 250,000 EP = 300,000 Total MP Cost (Configurable)
Active: [Active - Press] - Imaginary Space: Open a Spatial Storage with the size of a chest with 9x10 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 999 instead of 64. Stores the energy (MP Cost) of attacks blocked by Absolute Guard

The supreme authority over time and space, stopping the world, crossing time, and dominating enemies through Infinity Prison and Severance.

Passive
[Passive - Equipped] Magicule Seizure: The user's attacks have a 50% chance to seize 1% of an enemy's Magicules, restoring Magicules spent by the user.

[Passive - Equipped] Absolute Defense: Blocks all attacks using the formula C = A × 25, where C is the Magicule cost and A is the incoming damage. Attacks from opponents whose EP is at least 75% of the user's EP can bypass Absolute Defense.

[Passive - Equipped] Resistance Bypass: Bypasses resistances and treats nullifications as resistances.

Active
[Active - Press] Time Stop: Stops the entire world, leaving only the user able to act normally. Press again to restore the flow of the world. Costs 100,000 Magicules per second.

[Active - Press] Time Travel: Returns to the beginning of the world. Cooldown: 1,600 seconds.

[Active - Press] Infinity Prison: Costs 30,000 Magicules and imprisons the creature or player the user is looking at, sealing all movement and skill use. Drains 500 Magicules from the trapped target every 10 ticks. Lasts 300 seconds, increased to 600 seconds with Mastery. Cooldown: 20 seconds; missing still triggers the cooldown, reduced to 10 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Opens a spatial storage with 6 pages of standard chest capacity. Items stack to 999 instead of 64. It also stores the energy of attacks blocked by Absolute Defense, represented by the Magicules spent to block them.

[Active - Press] Severance Coating: Costs 1,000 Magicules and grants the user's attacks +50 damage and the Severance effect for 60 seconds. The damage bonus increases to +200 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Severance Blade: Costs 20,000 Magicules and fires an invisible projectile that deals 50 damage and inflicts Severance, increased to 300 damage with Mastery. The projectile is 5 blocks in size, increased to 10 blocks with Mastery. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

[Active - Press] Usurpation: Only works against opponents whose EP is higher than the user's. Steals one Spiritual Magic or skill from the target, limited to Common and Extra Skills. Success chance: 25%, increased to 50% with Mastery. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

[Active - Press] Replication: Copies one Spiritual Magic or skill from the target, limited to Common, Extra, and Intrinsic Skills. Success chance: 25%, increased to 50% with Mastery. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

[Active - Press] Forced Usurpation: Unlocked with Mastery. Functions like Usurpation, but only against targets whose EP is lower than the user's, with a 100% success rate. When used on a summon owned by a creature whose EP is no more than 75% of the user's EP, ownership of that summon is stolen. Costs 5,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
